milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the agent must navigate near the lime terracotta block and face it to demonstrate it has been located and visually identified. The target [4, 0, 6] is the spawn-relative position of the lime terracotta block (placed at the front of the stone brick structure). max_distance=8 gives the agent a reasonable detection range where the block is clearly visible in first-person view, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking toward the block rather than having stumbled past it.
